mentions.name: WeatherStage
mentions.description: Hosted SaaS dashboard for personal weather stations that displays weather station data in a simple web dashboard. It grew out of custom-built scripts and sites, is in a very early stage, and features are added based on the builder's own usage.
mentions.problem: Personal weather station data previously required custom build scripts and sites to visualize.
mentions.audience: Owners of personal weather stations, including the builder's family; hobbyists who want a hosted dashboard for their weather station data.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Hosted dashboard for your personal weather station.
